مَجُودٌ A field, or garden, rained upon: (A:) [or rained upon copiously, or abundantly.] And أَرْضٌ مَجْودَةٌ Land rained upon with a copious, or an abundant, rain. (S, L, K.) ―
-b2- (assumed tropical:) A man (S, A) affected with thirst: (S, A, K:) [or, with vehement thirst: (see جُوَادٌ:)] or at the point of death, or destruction. (K.) ―
-b3- And [hence,] (tropical:) Affected with longing desire. (L.) ―
-b4- Also (assumed tropical:) Overcome by drowsiness, or slumber: (TA:) or distressed by drowsiness, or slumber, &c. (Lh, L.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
